entries.effect: the CFString "memory", which the host's own Security.framework returns for this name (dlsym, compared as a string); no function of the port reads it
entries.reason: the option arrived in iOS 18; no function of the port reads the option, so it has no effect here, and the port carries the name with the value the host hands back
entries.source: the host's Security.framework by dlsym in tests/backports/host/commoncrypto/differential-constants.c; the 6.1.3 Security image exports no symbol of this name (tools/image-exports.lua, 660 exports); the SDK 26.2 declaration of the name, SecImportExport.h
